text: Lampago is an ancient Gangrel of unknown origin that used to lurk on the outskirts of Tucson, Arizona. Sire of the Courier, if they're Gangrel.

The Atlas Mk.27 was an assault rifle that was featured in Call of Duty: Future Warfare. However, when Future Warfare was canceled, the Atlas Mk.27 was discarded as well, and was never ported to any other future titles.
La Llorona, the White Woman is a Mekhet (Combatant) vampire from Mexico.
Kui-Xing, "The Minister of Stars" was a Metis Stargazer Theurge and part of the First Jade Sentai.
Kuanyn is a medium that works for the Midnight Circus. She is part of the Third Circle and one of the three mystics.
Armored Car Getaway is the ninth track in the Call of Duty 2 Soundtrack, with a runtime of 1:52.

La Celestina, also known by its alternative folkloric sobriquet the Bloody Mannequin, is a vampire mutilated through liberal use of Vicissitude - if its legend is to be believed, an entire artificial lifeform brought to unlife through the Embrace - stalking the streets of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colonia_Roma Colonia Roma] district of downtown Mexico City, no doubt a holdover from the recently-vacated Sabbat.
Kuritz is an eighth generation Ventrue of the Fiefs of the Black Cross realm. Following the , he Embraced the powerful Lucretia von Hardtz after she served him devoutly.
Kyle Ryper is the Ghoul of Brennon Thornhill. He was an Olympic powerlifter and is now the personal security guard of the Ventrue alongside his girlfriend, Sandra Oshe.
The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Kumiho is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Kumiho is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jewel Wang-mu.

Kyle McConner was a ninth generation Brujah antitribu of the Sabbat, and the sire of Alice Ménard. As a twisted pedophile, he Embraced the six-year-old Alice to be his sex doll, and then used Vicissitude to make her look like a porcelain doll. After a hundred or so years of abuse and rape, Alice challenged her sire to Monomacy, and destroyed him in her rage when he relented because of his twisted "love".
Lacramioara is ghoul of the Tzimisce Dracula and the captain of his household guard. New arrivals to Castle Dracula report directly to him.
The Armored Vehicle is a vehicle featured in Death March in Call of Duty Online. It serves as the primary escort objective throughout the mode.

The Lasombra Antediluvian is a powerful third generation vampire with mastery over the shadows of the Abyss, and the progenitor of the Lasombra clan. Lasombra is the name "modern" Cainites use (the term dates back to the Roman Empire). Around 1991 BCE, Lasombra was named Lau-Som-Bheu, which can be translated from Proto-Indo-European as "profiting by knowledge" or "profiting together through domination". His priests among the seafaring people worshipped him as Laza Omri Baras, the "God of the River of Darkness".
Les Invisibles is the name for wraiths of Creole descent that dwell primarily in the Mirrorlands - the Shadowlands reflection of the Caribbean and parts of North America.

Leukippes was a great Black Fury. According to legend, she slew a corrupt priest of Apollo named Kamisos around 650 B.C.E. She also fought in battle with her pack when the Scythians and Medes sacked Nineveh.
The Arcblade is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added as part of the Season Six update.

Leila Veil-Shredder is a rank 5 homid Ragabash Glass Walker, though she is presumed to be a metis, as she is severely sensitive to sunlight. She is an athletic Arab woman in her late 30s, with jet black hair that shows no gray that she keeps cut short. She has intense brown eyes and an intense unwavering gaze that makes people feel uncomfortable. She wears expensive business suits and absolutely refuses to wear a dress. She built her fortune from the ground up, and is Vice President of International Affairs of the Middle Eastern branch of a international medical supplies company. She is outspoken on women's issues and suspicious of men. She was the leader of a recently disbanded pack that struck a victory against Magadon Pharmaceuticals in Sudan, which caused trouble for Magadon around the world, and gave her and her comrades a reputation as successful monkeywrenchers. She is the Sept Leader of the Caern of the Solar Barque. She is rarely seen during the day, claiming that her job requires extensive travel. She is rumored to take men to her bed and exhaust them completely. The fact that she, a (presumed) metis and a woman managed to assume virtual command of both a corporation and her tribe impresses the Shadow Lords Her lack of metis gifts and the fact that she is rarely seen during the day leads some Garou to wonder if she is servant of the Wyrm or even an Abomination. The truth is that she was born Leila El-Sabeei, the daughter of a male Glass Walker and a human Kinfolk, a
Leechfinger is one of the sub-types of the Darkling seeming - Changeling who steal life from humans, grain by grain, drop by drop, with just a touch. Theirs is the blessing of Sap the Vital Spark.

]] Leaps-to-the-Wound, because she could jump so far above Sea's surface she looked like she might just fly away. One day she noticed that something had attached itself to her tail. She leaped and crashed, thrashing her tail back and forth trying to shake it loose, and finally, in frustration, used the Sending to call another Rokea to help her get the damned thing off. As soon as she did, it let go, and she saw it was a Remora. Leaps make a deal with Remora people, for battle against the Qyrall.

The Browning Automatic Rifle, abbreviated as the BAR, is an American light machine gun/automatic rifle found in every World War II installment of the Call of Duty series, as well as in Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Libra Mudfingers is a changeling who, on occasion, guides others through the Hedge and to Arcadia.

Lianne Miller is a Brujah residing in the Chicago area, she wants power over a commune, similar to how she could leech from anyone when she was young. Having a haven full of people willingly giving their blood is her idea of self-sufficiency. She’s had a few run-ins with the Camarilla in other cities while looking for a place to stay and doesn’t agree with their ideology at all.
Leah Swiftfoot is a Gangrel vampire introduced in the Rivals Expandable Card Game in The Wolf & The Rat expansion set.

The is a German Bismarck-class battleship encountered during the mission "Battleship Tirpitz" in the campaign of Call of Duty and Call of Duty: Classic. The 830-foot ship serves as the entire level. It also appears in the multiplayer map Ship in the aforementioned games and Call of Duty: United Offensive, much the same as its appearance in the campaign albeit at Sea in the Atlantic in the day time.
Levon "Emberclaw" Phillips is a Fire-Touched member of the Lex Talionis pack in Chicago.
, Ghost Wolf Ithaeur member of the Lodge of the Storm's Eye]] The Lodge of the Storm's Eye is an Ilthaeur lodge that practices a powerful spirit-binding rite.
Liu Dong is a Jiang Shi, a form of vampire native to the far East.

The Barrett .50cal (sometimes referred to as M82) is a semi-automatic sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It makes a minor appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Liolya the Eagle is a ninth generation Gangrel and a Road of the Beast follower of the Medieval period.
The weeping woman, the banshee. Humans have given them many names over countless centuries and across every continent, but in Bellatierra, it is always La Llorona.

Lost Boys are Spectres that, in life, were children who died as a result of their parents' criminal neglect. By the time these kids pass on, they are so beaten down by life that it is only a short fall to Spectredom.
The is a tracked, Russian-designed, amphibious Infantry Fighting Vehicle.
Lord Collum, the Master of Sludge, is the Maeljin of H'rugg, the Elemental Wyrm of Tainted Earth. He controls the Duchy of Sludge in Malfeas.
Lord Choke, the Master of Smog, is the Maeljin of Hoga, the Elemental Wyrm of Tainted Air, and controls the Duchy of Smog in Malfeas.
Lurker is one of the sub-types of the Darkling seeming. Victorian-era kith of master thieves and pickpockets. Theirs is the blessing of the Larcenous Fingers.

Private Bailey was an American soldier assigned to Able Company of the 1st Infantry Division, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. His signature weapon is the M1 Garand. Though he can be seen with the BAR.
Lurkglider is one of the sub-types of the Darkling seeming- winged creatures of the night. Theirs is the blessing of the Gargoyle’s Grace.
Lou Graham is a powerful Ventrue and the former Camarilla Prince of Seattle.

Lucas Dawnish is a homophobic policeman, and a Bastet of the Simba (werelion) tribe. Dawnish broke into a small local museum when he learned that they held a set of artifact stones etched with secret Mokolé lore, but the stones he wanted were not on display. The curator, Amos Roland, saw Dawnish in Crinos form, and reported the break-in. Ironically, Dawnish was dispatched to respond to the report along with Hank Machak. When Roland tried to tell them about the "bear" he saw break in, Dawnish derided his story and suggested he was making it up because he'd damaged the display himself. Later that night, he tracked Amos back to his home to look for the other stones in the set. He found Amos with Hank, and Dawnish took the time to spew some homophobic hate before attacking them. Hank, however, turned out to be a Mokolé himself, and he defeated Dawnish in the ensuing fight.

A is either a knife or spike at the end of the barrel of a gun that can be used to increase melee range. It is found as a weapon attachment in Call of Duty: World at War, Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Mobile, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and as an Operator Mod in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. Unusable bayonets can also be seen in Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts, Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, and it is a cut attachment from Call of Duty: Black Ops.
Ludmilla van der Holst is a Malkavian Methuselah from Brussels who during the 19th century influence the other Kindred in the area, seeking to maintain peace in her domain.
Lucia Merchant-Esposito is a psychic vampire active and seeking power in the criminal underworld.
Lucas Kight is a ghost who is searching for his missing father.

The was the standard heavy machine gun for the Royal Italian Army used during World War II. It is featured only in the Call of Duty 2: Big Red One campaign and can only be in the missions Operation Husky and Piano Lupo.

Lucca Taylor is a vampire and estranged childe of Eden Corliss, recently returning to Ottawa. Lucca manages Eden's money overseas, working with (among others) a firm in Dublin. The people there are terrified of anything going wrong with her accounts. When she flies in for a meeting, they clear out the entire building for her arrival and don't allow anyone back in until she's gone. Daniel Aoun claims to have seen one of the senior partners vomiting in the washrooms before a meeting with her.
Lucille is a Wraith who in life was killed for having interracial love with a white man in Georgia, USA. In death she portrays herself as a guardian angel watching over young lovers.
Stephanie Dela Pena, nowadays known by her folkloric sobriquet The Lost Girl of Little Baguio, is a wraith inhabiting the neighborhood in metro Manila after which she takes her name.
The Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress is an American four-engine heavy bomber aircraft used during World War II. It appears in many Call of Duty titles within the series.
Lu Chen, the Iron Master of 10,000 Perfections is a Scourgeling.

Ludmilla is a Tzimisce of the Carpathians during the Dark Ages, and the childe of Voivode Boleslav Volhyny. "Gentle Ludmilla" is so shy she stands away in shadow, and it is she who toys with the straps. During the Omen War, a captured Tremere ghoul agent named Stephen was captured on the lands and brought to Castle Volhyny, where he was presented to Ludmilla and her brood mates.
A Lost Soul is a wraith who has never had their caul removed or who had removed their own; they wander the Tempest.
:"I hope this works!" Baker One (B1) was a British Crusader Tank of the 7th Armoured Division that was the leader of Baker group, as seen in Call of Duty 2.
Madzimbabwe ("Court" in ) also known as the Court of Ghosts are a faction of the Euthanatoi of african heritage.

Lytek is the God of Exaltation and as such controls the time and place of all Celestial Exaltations, he also controls the time at which the Terrestrial Exalted Exalt. It is also his job to decide what memories an Exaltation carries with it from a previous life. Lytek was at one time a very well respected figure in the Bureau of Heaven; however, when the Usurpation occurred, Chejop Kejak had Lytek held captive for some time in order to collect the Exaltations of any Solars that had escaped the initial purge. This resulted in a huge loss of status, power and respect that has lasted until the reemergence of the Solar Exalted recently. Lytek owns a set of items crafted by Autochthon (known as the Divine Apparatae of Periapt Surgery) that allow for changes to be made in an Exalt's Shard, however one such item was lost within the year and Lytek has no idea who took it. It was kept under lock and key to such a degree that only the best thieves in Creation (or anywhere else) would be able to get at it. In appearance Lytek resembles a well-dressed citizen of the First Age composed entirely of light. Lytek is a god of the fourth grade and has knowledge of every charm ever conceived by an Exaltation that he has dealt with and is also able to radically decrease the time required for an Exalt to improve its Essence rating.

The Macellari are a bloodline of the Ventrue that were spawned in the ending nights of the Roman Empire. They see themselves as the crème de la crème of their Clan, exemplified by their rarified taste - which includes masses of vitae and even human flesh. The Macellari use their wealth to cultivate a number of tastes in mortal blood, viewing themselves gourmandizing vintners of exceptional draughts of Vitae. Their havens are often opulent and shared with at least two other members of the bloodline who act as their compatriots during their dinners and keep the mortal cattle fed. All Macellarius are invited into the blood because they demonstrate an unswerving commitment to fulfilling their abnormal hungers. The vampires of this lineage begin to grow larger upon inclusion into the bloodline. Their flesh swells and distends as the dead fat within the body multiplies painfully. The vampire, over the course of three nights, gains an additional 100 to 150 pounds upon her frame. With each passing year, they become even more obese.

The BTR-80 is a Soviet eight-wheeled Armored Personnel Carrier and Infantry Fighting Vehicle that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War.

Magda, also known as the "Witch of Connaught" and "The Thief", is a fearsome Lhiannan of Ireland. She not only hunted Garou and Kinfolk but also destroyed entire caerns. Magda appears as a feral child, her outward appearance mimicking her wild heart. Her clothing — when she wears any — is little more than rags and is covered in dirt. Tattoos and mystic sigils mark her pale skin and her dark hair is matted with blood and filth. She is one of the greatest enemies of the Fianna in Ireland.
Ma-Ha-Suchi is a Lunar Exalted warlord, mutated by exposure to the Wyld, who dwells in the East of Creation.

Madame Zhou was a changeling refugee from the Ming dynasty active during the reign of Louis XIV. An irascible and gloomy sort, she nonetheless was a loyal woman, a lifelong ally to any who would succeed in winning her over. Zhou was noted as one of the most skilled oneiromancers of the age.

The was an air and ground engagement between the American forces and the Italian forces backed by German armor in the Battle of Gela. The Battle of Piano Lupo took place in the Piano Lupo Valley, as portrayed in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Malakh is a Devourer. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Alejandro de la Vega.
Magdiel is a Slayer. She is possessing the body of a mortal known as Anila Kaul.
Malchus was a powerful Carthaginian Brujah and the sire of Zamra. He became an Apostate Baali due to his affiliations in the city.
The BTR-60 is an 8 wheeled Soviet Armored Personnel Carrier that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.
Máddji, known as the "Mistress of Szlachtas", is a prominent Tzimisce antitribu Anarch.
Mahtiel, The Sleeper, is a Warrior Salubri of great renown. She is one of the Twelve conspirators of Hunedoara bound to the demon Nikanuuranu.

Mamu is a Lupus Ahroun Red Talon from Australia. In 1999 he was preparing to slay several Mokolé and Peter Ward, the Glass Walker accompanying them, when the Progenitor Wolf manifested and stopped him. This caused Mamu to flee in shame and Rage, and he has not definitively been seen since; sighting and rumors persist, though, suggesting he roams Australia's wilderness, wreaking havoc.

The is a bolt-action sniper rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Strike Team. It was first seen in the Multiplayer reveal trailer for Black Ops II. In Strike Team, it is automatically given a Suppressor.

With the activation of this Manifestation, the Sin-Eater gains the frightening power to reach out with her plasm to seize control of objects, animals, and even people. To those with the sight to see it, the Sin-Eater reaches out with her hand, and invisible tendrils of plasm reach out to the object of her desire, ensnaring it (or him) and compelling obedience.

Manny Sideways is a homid Ratkin Tunnel Runner and a member of the Ahadi. By his own admission, he joined the cross-Breed alliance to try to prove his worth to the other Ratkin, who look down on homids. Manny is a knowledgeable Umbral traveller, a healer, and a seasoned thief. His wise advice allows his and Ghunbari's mission through the Atrocity Realm a chance of success. Despite the usual animosity between Ratkin and Garou, Manny supports the mission's goal to seek alliance with the African Silver Fangs by rescuing one of their treasures from Banes.

Maria is a Mekhet draugr defined primarily by her sloth. Though much of her unlife is unknown, she was beaten into torpor in Nogales at some point, an experience that drained out the last of her Humanity. From there, she traveled to a slaughterhouse, where she remains even now, sated, in the ever-streaming blood.

The Bacon Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who buys the Bacon Pack for 160 Microsoft Points and $1.99 on PlayStation 3 and PC. Bacon camouflage adds a bacon-styled pattern to the main body of the weapon with small droplets covering it. Other parts of the weapon are black and covered in what appears to be a layer of grease.

Marcus is a Sabbat Tzimisce and a powerful Ductus within the Nomad Coalition, an army of nomadic packs and warbands. He participated in the Siege of Atlanta in 1999 and engaged the Camarilla forces within the High Museum of Art, being personally responsible for defeating and capturing the powerful Brujah Archon Julius.
In life, Mark Creed was an embittered paraplegic who loved computers and heavey metal music. In death as a wraith, Mark became a part of the Silent Legion and decides to live his unlife how he wants.

Marcus C. Andrews was a seventh generation City Gangrel of the Sabbat, and the sire of Sébastien Goulet. He was diablerized by his childe, who rose in the ranks to become Ductus of the Montreal Sabbat.
Barrel Changing is a weapon attachment that appears in Call of Duty Online.
Marissa the Butcher is a violent ninth generation Brujah of the London Anarchs.

Mary the Black, also known as Ma-ri-ah and Black Mariah, is a Baali methuselah of great renown. She was born as Ma-ri in the city of . At a young age she became a ghoul of the Toreador methuselah Mi-ka-il, but was abandoned by him and killed herself during the siege of her city. Infernalists resurrected her centuries later, and she was subsequently Embraced as a Baali by Anaduk. During the fall of Constantinople in 1204 CE she committed diablerie on both Peter the Humble and the hated Michael, who was the Patriarch of Constantinpole's Cainites and the leader of the Dream.
Meat Pudding is a Fostern Metis Ahroun Bone Gnawer who lives in Egypt.

The Battle Hind is a 9-pointstreak featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts. Allows players to call in a friendly Mi-24 Hind to attack enemy players using a chain gun and rocket pods. It was originally a 6-pointstreak. It uses a machine gun turret to target enemy infantry from a distance. It will kill those that are standing right below by dropping bombs. If targets are further across the map, it will fire rockets. In general, it seems to follow the standard loop path around the map except when it has identified a target, in which case it seems to move to the target's position, sometimes flying backwards to get there. The Hind is a faster, more mobile, and more heavily equipped version of Modern Warfare's Attack Helicopter.
Matthias of Bath is a 7th generation Salubri and the childe of Generys. He is a renowned healer and historian of his clan, and companion of the Warrior Caste Yael.
Mistress Mary Widowe is an Unseelie black widow Pooka Wilder.
Marquise Tistresse, also known as the Scarlet Widow, is a spider hobgoblin who gains power by devouring her victims, be they human, hobgoblin, or Gentry.

Automatic Fire is an attachment in Call of Duty: Ghosts. It changes the weapon's default three-round-burst mode into fully automatic fire mode. This makes it more competitive at close-range, but sacrifices long-range effectiveness. The attachment is available for two weapons. The first is the MSBS. On the MSBS, the automatic fire rate is decreased by 4.8% compared to the original fire rate per burst, dropping from 833 to 793 rounds per minute. As well, Automatic Fire on this weapon causes every multiplier (barring the head) to drop to 0.9x, making the MSBS almost always need 3 shots instead of two. The Automatic Fire attachment is also an integral attachment on the Gold PDW. The fire rate is increased from 789 RPM per burst (446 RPM overall) to 857 RPM, and the damage multiplier to the head is decreased from 1.5x to 1.2x. The magazine size of the Gold PDW is increased to 20 rounds to compensate for the higher rate of fire. However, it is only unlocked after obtaining a Multiplayer rank of Prestige 10.
Marta Laughs-at-Fear is a Homid Ahroun Wendigo. She appears in Rage. She throws Stillwater Packmother into the Hoover Dam's generators for violating the Litany for siring a Metis cub.
Mary Sutton is a Iron Master Ithaeur member of the Lodge of Metal.
Mary Harris was a poor woman in life who mothered two infant sons until a tragic fire took their lives, and she took her own in despair. As a wraith, Mary became a part of the Silent Legion.
Badger-Two is the callsign of a tank commander of an M1A2 Abrams and a playable character that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is playable in the mission "Severed Ties".

Matlal was a scribe who lived during the time of the Aztec Empire. Though supposedly skilled at his work, in truth, he had long been surpassed by his daughter Centehua, whom he had taught to read, write, fight, and possibly Skinchange. He had outsourced most of his best work to Centehua. Though he was slated to be sacrificed, Centehua managed to spare him that fate.
Massimiliano is a powerful Gangrel and the Anarch Baron of Belo Horizonte.

Martin D'Richet, using the alias of Aaron Carson, is a powerful mage of New York City who used Raymond the Caitiff to open a blood auction in New Orleans for elder vampires. He is allied with several Tremere antitribu and wages a shadow war against Prince Marcel Guilbeau of New Orleans for being responsible for his daughter Marie d'Richet's tranformation into a vampire.

The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops III.
Mathias Geber is a Ventrue of the Frankfurt Rhine-Main Camarilla.

:For other uses of the names "Medusa" or "Gorgons", see Medusa and Gorgon. The Medusae, also known as the Gorgons, were the very first Black Fury pack. It consisted of Euryale, Helena, Stheno, Medusa, and Isthmene. They are also called the First Daughters, and the Black Furies therefore call themselves the Second Daughters. They eventually became totems.
Meeks is a Chimera forced against their will to work for Pentex.
The Beast Camouflage is a DLC weapon camouflage skin available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is available for anyone who buys the Beast Pack. It is a recoloured version of the Rogue camouflage
Michelle Davis is a Malkavian of the Boston Camarilla. She is captured by the Second Inquisition during Operation Swansong.
Michael Giovanni is a Giovanni cainite and the head of security of Benito Giovanni and his clan's operations in Atlanta, in 1999. He is strong-willed and militant-mannered.
Ming Hu is a mage and a member of the Wu Lung Tiger School. He resides in Hong Kong, China.
The Bal-27 is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Mother Larissa is the Sept Leader of the Sept of the Green in New York City's Central Park. She is an elder theurge of the Bone Gnawers.

Mortwights, also known as New-Fallen or Mutilé during the Twilight Era, are spirits of those who died extremely violent deaths. Their rage and anger towards their death causes them to awaken in the Shadowlands as Spectres, never existing as a wraith. Many Mortwights had dark natures to begin with, and some believe they were destined to be Spectres from the beginning.

:For the legacy from Mage: The Awakening, see Morphean Continuity. Deep within the Skein, the ancient Morpheans rule over the dream in a manner that not even the Gentry can match. Some changelings find the fact of their existence a comfort: evidence that the Fae aren’t the strongest supernatural powers. These Lost have rarely actually met a Morphean, for if they had, they’d know that just as the Others have no monopoly of power, they have no special claim on cruelty, either. Morpheans partake of the purest essence of dreams, and it’s in a dream’s nature to choose symbolism over morality. A Morphean never manifests randomly. Changelings seek them out by traveling to an appropriate dream, or encounter them when the Wyrd wills it. They possess an inconstant omniscience, which is to say that they sometimes know secrets that have never been told, but occasionally can’t even remember the same of a supplicant. There’s no way to know whether this is a trick or the product of an incomprehensible consciousness. Morpheans are mighty archetypes and living enigmas. Each one is unique, though all can appear in many places at once. Beyond their raw power and mysterious natures they have one thing in common: they want to express their natures in the waking realm. They have no flesh and no powers that can freely pierce the barriers of sleep, so they make bargains, recruiting string dreamers to do their bidding.

Backdraft Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is available with the purchase of the Backdraft Pack. When equipped, it makes the weapon look like it's burning. Backdraft Personalization Pack AW.jpg|The Backdraft Pack poster.

Momma Rat is a Ratkin. She underwent her Infection in the 1960s. She began living in her trailer in 1972, and eventually became too fat to leave it in Homid form without destroying it. She is revered by other Ratkin for her fertility.
Morwen is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion and the sister and Seneschal of High King David
Mouette is a Seelie Selkie Wilder and member of the Rocky Shore Freehold.
The BRM is a fully-automatic light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: Heroes and a scrapped weapon from Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
Monica Hawthorne is a Homid Glass Walker Garou in North Carolina.

Mow'ruth the Hunter is an Animal Kami Host who lives in the wild country of rural New Hampshire. Gaia has charged him with overseeing the balance of "his" realms and making certain that the encroaching human population does not extend too far. He accomplishes his task in various ways - by appearing to lead lost humans to safety, by acting as a hidden menace and frightening off intruders and by conducting guerrilla warfare on unwary campers or hikers. He can and sometimes does befriend humans, but refuses any attempts at domestication.

Mordecai ben Judah was a Rabbi and leader of the Kabbalists of Prague in the late 12th century. He created the Golem of Prague to protect the Jewish Quarter from dark forces but was killed by his creation after the treacherous Cappadocian Mercurio corrupted it. His son Mendel became the new Rabbi and helped the Brujah defeat the Golem.

Ban and Protect is a system in Call of Duty: Black Ops III for Arena. The feature allows the players to select an item, whether it be a weapon, scorestreak, perk, etc. to ban or protect for the match. Banning an item restricts its usage in the match, whereas protect gambles to prevent an item from being banned, if anyone voted for it. Settings can increase how many times a player can do so.

Morel is an eighth generation Malkavian and the sire of the infamous Antoine the Lost. One of their ghouls, a school's dean, told Morel about his crazy student Antoine and this led Morel to Embrace Antoine. Without any guidance, Antoine would return to his family and kill them in a frenzy.
Mrs. Fitzgerald is a twelfth generation Ventrue ancilla of the London Camarilla.
Nasch, also known as The Circassian, is a Ventrue who had managed to drink the blood of Set himself. He has since served as a catalyst for Anarch activity, although unwillingly.

The Autonomous Sentry Platform (ASP) is a quadruped robotic battle tank in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. It appears in both the campaign and Combat Immersion modes. Both units are capable of being controlled and piloted using Enhanced Remote Hijack, but are otherwise invulnerable to other Control-related Cyber Cores. Hijacking will not work in Hypocenter or Life.

Natasha Ferdman, "Moon Chaser" is a Homid Ragabash Silent Strider. She becomes the de facto leader of the Silent Striders in Russia. She eventually travels to Las Vegas and uses the Rite of the Time Tunnel to view the past to find a way to defeat the Storm Eater.
Nebmaatsutekh was a Setite methuselah known to be able to withstand the sunlight for an entire day.
Nancy Martin was drug addict who was accidently killed during a police drug raid. As a wraith she became part of the Emerald Legion.

The Baseball Bat is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops III, Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, and making brief appearances in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

Nefersobk (also known as The Crocodile Queen) is a Shuankhsen featured in the Mummy: The Curse Rulebook. Nefersobk began her life as a slave to embalmers in The Nameless Empire. She was a human tool, spending days carefully stitching skin and salting bodies according to [https://www.smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/ancient-egyptian-papyrus-demystifies-embalming-techniques-180977147/ precise] specificons. Her brilliance saved her from being sacrificed more than once, and since her work was so fine, no one wanted to take her away from it, saving her from rapes and beatings. By her own estimation, this provided her with a better life than most other slaves. She suffered from [https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/scoliosis/symptoms-causes/syc-20350716 scoliosis], and a lopsided face, causing her enslavers to call her "Beauty of the Crocodile" as a cruel joke. Once her masters decided she really was more valuable dead than alive, however, nothing could save her. Her masters did not hesitate, but they were unused to murder, and did not have the skills to kill her quickly or painlessly. . Over the course of an hour, she was beaten to death. While terrible, this taught her a valuable lesson: Only the powerful are truly human. The weak are their tools, and their scrap. Nefersobk shortly thereafter into a stolen corpse, screaming. She adapted quickly, owning to her great intelligence, which was then enhanced by Sekhem. She tracks a number of Arisen through multiple incarnations

Natasia is a Fifth Generation Brujah methuselah and the sire of Yitzhak ben Avraham. During the Medieval period, she lived as a prostitute in Krakow, where she befriended the Rabi Ariel Reuben. The Rabbi's son, Yitzhak, eventually took her companionship and she revealed her nature to him. His caring and sympathy earned him the Embrace, when she decided to preserve his kindness eternally.

Nahash is a Followers of Set elder who reside in Reims during the Dark Ages. The lover of Nicodemus the Simonian , they have created the Church of Venus Serpent , a cult of hedonistic mortals which leads to their death , or their embrace (and most of the time also their death afterward) . Some of the dogma of the cult is very close to Lilith's mythology , and Bahari could be interested in it. The relationship between Nicodemus and Nahash is as strange as it is profound, and no one will likely ever fully understand it. The two Cainites exchanged their hearts, extracted by Setite Sorcery reimplanted Vicissitude. They also sometimes merge their body in an embrace as repulsive as it is fascinating, blending the abilities of both clan.
The Ballista EM3 is a heavy weapon in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and an Operator Skill in Call of Duty: Mobile.

Nockers are the artisans among the Kithain, able to craft the stuff of dreams into whatever they desire. Their creations are always flawed, however, and their knowledge of this curse makes them irritable and quick to anger.

A New Stygian, or an Imperialist or an Insurrectionist to opponents, was a wraith of the Hierarchy that supported the Smiling Lord and his Grim Legion during the Great War. They are opposed by the Loyalists of Charon.

Nicolai Antonescu is the Tremere member of the Chicago primogen. Although he has the appearance of a ten-year-old boy, he is actually an elder who has accumulated a great amount of power, both temporal and Thaumaturgical, over his seven centuries of existence. He has participated in Chicago's primogen council since shortly after his arrival in the city in the 19th century.

The is an American medium bomber aircraft which entered service during World War II. It saw extensive usage in the Normandy landings. The B-25 first appeared in Call of Duty: WWII as multiple appears in the opening sequence of the level "D-Day". A crashed B-25 Mitchell can be seen in a river in the multiplayer map Market Garden from the United Front DLC and another can be seen destroyed across the river.
Nicolai Predatelski is a Russian Homid Ahroun Silver Fang Fostern.

Nimue was a Fairest whose Keeper was the Pale Maiden, back in the days before she had become the Pale Dowager. After the True Fae heard of a prophecy that would spell her doom, she began destroying her realm, turning it into the Alabaster Sanctum. During the frenzy, Nimue escaped.

Nike was a Greek sorcerer who worked alongside Sraosha and Ptah to fight off a monster. In addition to her magic, Nike bore some skill with the knife, which she attempted to use against the creature when it captured her.

The was the final battle of the Petropavlovsk Campaign. The capture of a nuclear submarine by Task Force 141 personnel caused a nuclear missile to be launched as an EMP to disable Russian and American equipment on the US Eastern Coast, turning the tide of the Battle of Washington D.C..
Nikolaus Vermeulen is a powerful Nosferatu and the Camarilla Prince of Brussels.
Nuwisha are were-coyotes, one of the Changing Breeds of the World of Darkness.

Octavio, referred to as the "Voice of Kupala", was a 6th generation Malkavian, a mad prophet obsessed with the eight signs of Gehenna, believing himself to be the personification of Havnor, the god of war and lightning. Octavio spent the centuries warning others of the coming of the signs. He finally sank into a fit of despair, convinced that he has failed to have any effect on Kupala whatsoever. Octavio would then allow Anatole to diablerize him, making Anatole keeper of the mysteries and the harbinger of Gehenna.

The Ballistic Calibration is an attachment featured in Call of Duty: WWII, unlocked by achieving weapon level 2 with sniper rifles. It functions similarly to the Ballistics CPU in previous games as it reduces the idle sway when aiming with a sniper rifle. It does not affect rifles equipped with the 4x Optic or the Iron Sights attachments.

Odd Arm was a True Fae active during the Three Kingdoms period of China. This Stranger was a lonely, deformed creature with one arm and three eyes. It would kidnap mortals and change them to appear more like itself in an effort to stave off that loneliness.

Old Man Manyskins (a.k.a Laughing Manyskins) is a Nuwisha. He may have been responsible for the defeat of General Custer at the Battle of Little Big Horn due to deliberate spreading of misinformation.
Old One-Eye is a Theurge Black Spiral Dancer. He appears in Rage.

The Ballistic Conversion Kit is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It converts an energy weapon into a ballistic weapon, altering its attachments to fit the usual set found on ballistic weapons, such as FMJ, Rifled Barrel, Extended Mags and Hollow Points. The gun perk also removes the standard magazine regeneration and bullet reflection traits to include ballistic traits such as cover penetration. It is exclusive to the Volk - Retro and Vintage variants. On the September 6th, 2017 patch, the perk was updated to have reduced recoil for the first few shots and have a faster ADS time.

Orobas, also called the Master of Toads, is a powerful Earthbound demon active during the Dark Ages. A warped, primal force of gluttony and physical lust, Orobas manifests as a grotesque, toad-like figure, at once slightly comical and deeply, viscerally repellent.

Oneiropomp is a changeling or other creature that enters the dreams of another. Skilled oneiropomps are capable of discovering the approach of the fae through the signs the oneiropomps find in the dreams of mortals. Oneiropomps are also capable of helping those whose dreams these changelings guard to find more meaning and fulfillment in their dreams.
In life Ominey Stanton was a conductor who enjoyed trains. He died when he fell onto the tracks of a subway train. As a wraith he became a part of the Emerald Legion.
The Battleworn Weapon Kit is a Bounty weapon kit available in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered.

Orlando Bianchi is a Nosferatu Anarch and neonate of Milan. He was a professional martial artist whose career was ended by Mafia enforcers. He abhors bullies and has vowed never to be oppressed again, finding a new place among the Anarchs and working with a coterie to overthrow the local Camarilla regime.

Oswald is a ninth generation Nosferatu and the sire of Toby. Residing in Washington, D.C., he employed a mortal Toby as his personal hacker and eventually embraced him to save his life after Toby was gunned down.

Outflyers are a type of Spectre found in Orpheus. Their sudden appearance as a new Spectre breed puzzled many, but what is known is they seem to serve as the perimeter guards for a Spectral hive's territory. Resembling giant, monstrous sea urchins, an Outflyer can use its many sharp quills to impale enemies and inject them with Spectral ichor in defense. They are not overtly aggressive, but will defend their territories from any intruders, mortal, ghost, or Spectre. Outflyers, because of their guardian nature, tend to be the type of Spectre most involved in territory skirmishes, particularly against other Outflyers.
An is a type of self-loading rifle that is capable of fully-automatic fire.
Owl is a Totem of Wisdom, a hidden stalker in the darkness. It is the totem and Patron Spirit of the Silent Strider Tribe.
Pacifico Grillati is an 8th generation Lasombra Ancilla in Jerusalem, childe of Paliuro Rustucci.

Patience is a Nosferatu of the London Camarilla. She is present in the party previous to the Fall of London. She dressed in rags and described cleverly sneaking past several different hunters, and getting them to shoot each other with clever misdirection. Patience is quiet and unassuming, but has a long memory.
The is a Specialist Weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Petros the Unyielding was a Silver Fang Ahroun who lived in approximately 2000 B.C.E. He was murdered by Vinata, a corrupt Nagah. He had been carrying a message to the west to Konstantos the Savage, a fellow Silver Fang, telling him to stop harassing the Fera. His death, and the Gurahl refusal to resurrect him, triggered the first War of Rage.
Petra was an especially horrid Nosferatu that embraced the former prostitute Jara Drory at the small fishing village of Vis, in the coast Yugoslavia.
Paxton is a Loyalist under the employ of a True Fae known as the Hoarfrost Witch.
The is an automatic rifle featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Penanggalan (singular penanggal) are a form of non-Kindred vampire that prefers to feed on the blood of pregnant women and babies. This creature is notable for its tendency to travel far afield.
Pietro is an old Nosferatu living in the sewers of Venice, during modern nights. He assisted the Banu Haqim Justice during their investigation into the Hecata of the city.

The Peripheral Man, more often dubbed the Oneiric Entity in official reports, is the folkloric sobriquet of an enigmatic member of the Fair Folk (more likely some form of True Fae rather than a changeling of any variety) inhabiting the edges of reality around Burlington College.
The BPR2000 Tech is a bullpup assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online.

Pierre Beauvais is a Gangrel of the 18th century and the sire of Jebediah Roney, from the line of Welsh monster Blaidd. In the mid 16th century, Pierre Beauvais and his fellow French soldiers are hunted in the woods during the French Indian wars. His squad was obliterated by the Gangrel Ragnar Nordstrom and Pierre, the sole survivor, was embraced. Fifty years after, Pierre himself embraced Jebediah.

Ponticulus was a mage of the House Tremere, and one of the closest advisors of the founder of that house. He died in 980 during the ritual of consecration of Ceoris, but later returned as a wraith in order to write his posthumous testament.

Predator Magath are the memories of ancient animals from the fossils found in Colorado. No longer dinosaur-spirits, but powerful and deadly magath, these hunters continue to stalk the deep places in the spirit wilds. Millennia of experience have honed their talents for ambush and stealth to exceptional levels, yet robbed them of truly comprehensible forms.
The Backhander is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Apocalypse Z.

: For other uses of the word psion, see psion (disambiguation). Psions, Homo sapiens mentis, are artificially-created forms of psychomorphs in the 22nd century. The media came up with the term after bastardizing the term for the psion, the particle representing psi as the fifth, unifying force (along with gravity's gravitons, electromagnetism's photons, the strong nuclear force's gluons and the weak nuclear force's bosons). A latent, when found, is placed in their choice of eight Prometheus Chambers, or "tanks." The tank is a highly advanced form of biotech. A breathing apparatus is placed over the mouth and nose of the latent. The apparatus fills the lungs with a breathable liquid, while the rest of the chamber fills up with a different liquid. The chamber slightly alters the latent on a genetic level, "triggering" them to noetic awareness. The latent is now a psion, and capable of accessing the full range of noetic ability. However strong their potential might be, however, the Prometheus Chambers were designed by their creators to limit access to a single Aptitude. Each Chamber triggers latents to a different Aptitude. The discovery of a method to break down this artificial location is of prime importance to several of the Psi Orders. The first psions to be created thus were the eight proxies, each of which is an expert in their selected Aptitude. In game terms, it's possible they may be represented by having six dots in each Mode of their particular Aptitude. They can, at
A Qutb is a high-ranking member of the Ahl-i-Batin, a master of Mind magic responsible for leading and organizing the Craft.

The Ravnos Antediluvian is the fabled progenitor of the vampiric clan Ravnos. Its nature is shrouded in lies and half-truths, perhaps even more so than most of the Antediluvians – the Ravnos are known for being tricksters and liars, and there is certainly a measure of truth to that stereotype. On the other hand, they might argue that the real value of storytelling comes from the lessons learned and impressions made rather than preserving the facts of a time long past. Either way, there are widely different portrayals of the clan's founder and almost no stories of him since recorded history. Whatever the true story might be, the Eldest Ravnos rose in India in 1999 during the Week of Nightmares and was eventually destroyed by a mighty conflagration of supernatural factions. In the 2020s, a vial of his blood was disputed by several factions in New York City.

Ballistic may refer to: *Ballistic Knife - A special/melee weapon in the Black Ops series and in Call of Duty Online. *Ballistics CPU - An attachment for sniper rifles in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty Online, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, Call of Duty: Black Ops III and Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. *Ballistic Calibration - An attachment for sniper rifles in Call of Duty: WWII. *Ballistic Shield - A specialist weapon in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4. *Ballistic Vests - A pointstreak reward in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Ghosts. *Ballistic Vest Duffel Bag - An item related to the aforementioned pointstreak. *Ballistic Conversion Kit - A gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. *Ballistics Lab - A military structure in Call of Duty: Heroes. *Ballistic Missile Defense - A defense in Call of Duty: Black Ops III. *Ballistics Be Damned - An achievement/trophy in Call of Duty: WWII. *Intercontinental Ballistic Missile - A nuclear weapon in some games of the series. *Going Ballistic - An achievement in Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified. *Kendall Ballistics - A weapon manufacturer in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.
Rayzeel is a Salubri methuselah, a childe of Saulot himself, and a follower of the Valeren Path of the Healer. Among her clanmates, she was renowned for her gift of song.
Rasalon is a 6th generation Nosferatu, childe of Androvikus.
Revenants are ghouls for whom the condition has become hereditary, and who are capable of generating vitae within their own veins. ]]

A is a type of weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. Battle Rifles are defined by the use of a semi-automatic or fully-automatic mode combined with mid to long range effectiveness, with high damage but high recoil.
The Red Prince of Dreams was a powerful True Fae, very proud of his ability to inspire fear. According to legend, he was the oathbreaker who caused the entire fae kind's dire vulnerability to Iron.
René Devereaux is a Seelie alligator Pooka who resides just outside of New Orleans.
Clawless is a Lupus Theurge Red Talon. He is a lunatic and the Valkenburg Foundation gave him a serum to keep him in breed form.
The is a battle rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III.

Redford is a powerful Ventrue of the Caribbean, and the sire of the infamous pirate Charles Vane. He lived as a god king of Carib Indians in a small island off the coast of Jamaica, during the . He was a white man of European origin who hunted a mortal Vane and Embraced him after he impressed the Ventrue. He mentored Vane but his childe soon fled his grasp and was buried at sea for centuries.

Rhys of Tregaron is a powerful Brujah of medieval Wales. Some Cainites of Deheubarth, in southern Wales, refused to acknowledge Baron Seren's authority. One of the strongest opposition came in Rhys, who has left the last two Gloucester emissaries staked on the edge of his domain.
Robert Pedder, known in his prime as the "Tai-pan", was the prince of Hong Kong before he was ousted by the vengeful native Kuei-jin.
Battle Blade is the fourth track of the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II Season 2 (Official Game Soundtrack). It is composed by , with a runtime of 2:35.
Richard Justice is a former Pentex employee who was turned into a vampire.
Rolf Reiter is a Vampire whose Haven is in Lemon City, not far outside Miami.

Roger is a ninth generation Nosferatu and the childe of Strand Master Lawrence Meeks. Trained by his sire, he was an agent of the local Nosferatu intelligence network, Embraced to replace the network's reliability on vampires of different clans.

Auto Sniper appears as a Common gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, appearing exclusively on the "Raze" Prototype Weapon of the UDM. Much like the Sniper Mod gun perk, it turns the fully-automatic pistol into a compact sniper rifle, which includes a custom sniper scope but keeps the automatic fire mode.
Private Robin Williams is a wraith from the House of the Fallen Sun.

Roderigo is a Giovanni Ghoul and the head coachman of Claudius Giovanni. He has been secretly bribed by Hardestadt against his master, and helps sabotage the Conspiracy of Isaac and protect the lost Children of Isaac.
Lord Ruthven is a powerful 4th generation Tzimisce of mysterious origins.

The Beast Fifty Long Barrel is a barrel for the JAK Harbinger Kit of the M4 Assault Rifle. It is featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III as part of the Aftermarket Parts system and was added as part of the Season Four update.

Roxana is a Lasombra member of Andrew Emory's pack. She looks like a wrestler, even though in life she had been just as much a nerd in her own right. She had exceptional finesse when it came to shadow control and is experienced in Abyss Mysticism. During a Vaulderie, Lucita de Aragón had an insight on Roxana's persona, so young and yet already so thoroughly inhuman. She scarcely has a soul as Lucita conceives it, having purged herself of most emotions and nearly all attachments. She is a conscious tangle of inhuman desires and the basest of instincts, and is very happy with the condition. She has no thought for Lucita beyond contempt for the Elder's failures and attachment to lost life.

A fallen Euthanatos (barrabi or Nephandi), Ru Mang resides on a small island where he operates a temple and a school. He is secretly conducting experiments in reanimation of corpses. Successful zombies become his personal attendants and couriers. He wishes to usher in the Sixth Age as he knows the terror and bloodshed will help provide him with souls to offer to his Mistress.

Rowena is a Gangrel elder and the Sheriff of West London. She is a feisty warrior from Ireland and staunch supporter and enforcer of the Camarilla Traditions. Her fierceness often puts her at odds with other Sherriffs. During Operation Antigen, she is last seen leading a rogue group of Kindred to fight the hunters on the street. Could potentially be found if needed to face down Operation Antigen.
The is a 1/2 or 3/4 ton 4×4 utility vehicle manufactured by the People's Republic of China. It is featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts, Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare and Call of Duty: Mobile.
Beware this creature's speed. They tend to travel in packs, overwhelming their prey by sheer numbers. The dogs are extremely tenacious and deadly.
Runi the Grey She-wolf is a sixth generation Gangrel elder of Medieval Normandy. She is allied with the Brujah Arngrim le Fier to reconquer Normandy from the Ventrue.

Rowena Alden is a seventh generation Tzimisce and a Priscus of Toronto. She mentored her childe Stephen Bateson well in the arts of infiltration and thaumaturgy, before having him infiltrate the Tremere chantry in Hong Kong.
The is an assault rifle that is set to appear in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Roxy is a ninth generation Gangrel and the Primogen of the New Orleans Camarilla.
Runs-Wild is a werewolf traveler of Ardenmore from the Arcadia CCG.

Satyrs are a Changeling kith sprung from dreams of revelry, lust and passion. They throw a party like no-one else, drinking, fighting and loving harder than most mortals would ever dare. They are physically adept and, like the god Pan, may inflame the passions of others through music and dance, but all the revelling leaves them with little willpower to resist temptation.
Sergeant Benny Church was an American soldier in Able Company, 1st Infantry Division, under the command of Lt. Walker. He appears solely in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.

Sascha Vykos, born Myca Vykos, is the signature character of the Tzimisce clan in Vampire: The Masquerade and Dark Ages: Vampire. This androgynous character – a Noddist scholar, Tzimisce scientist and Cainite monster – has long been a staunch supporter of Sabbat freedom, and acts as its chief torturer. A musician with a scalpel, Sascha understands the nuances of every physical sensation and the nerves best suited to receive its ministrations. They are also a creature of learning, with a collection of books and artifacts to humble the halls of all academia. Sascha's enemies, including the Gangrel Beckett and the Malkavian Anatole, believe they hold cult-status within the Sabbat, wherein sect members emulate their actions. In truth, however, Sascha is a monster beyond their own years. Few could ever understand the grand schemes of the Sabbat's ronin Priscus.
Sana was a Thin-blooded Vampire living in New York City. She went on a mortal killing spree claiming orders from Caine Himself. For this, she met her final death by Sheriff Qadir al-Asmai.
Sarka was a Brujah vampire introduced in the Rivals Expandable Card Game's The Heart of Europe expansion set.
Private Beebe is an American soldier of Able Company, 1st Infantry Division and under the command of Lt. Walker. He is seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Saule is an eleventh generation Gangrel and gang leader of the Dead Ferals within the Boston Anarchs.
Sasha is a Brujah from San Francisco. She was embraced as a provocation for being the great-great-grandchilde of the Ventrue Prince Julian Luna.

In life Scarlett Cramden, real name Myrtle Cramden, was a disgruntled house wife who murderd her own husband burned down her home along with herself in it. In death, she became a wraith of the Hierarchy of Atlanta and became a part of the Ponce de Leon Ladies Haunting Society.

Blue Tiger Camo is a weapon camouflage featured in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Black Ops II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered and Call of Duty: Black Ops 4.
Scott Frances is a wraith character featured in the adventure, "Shadow of Doubt" from the Midnight Express book.

Satan, also known as the Devil, is an entity in Abrahamic religions who entices humans into sin or falsehood. In Judaism, Satan is seen as an agent subservient to God, typically regarded as a metaphor for the yetzer hara, or 'evil inclination'. In Christianity and Islam, he is usually seen as a fallen angel or jinn who has rebelled against God, who nevertheless allows him temporary power over the fallen world and a host of demons.

The Sebek are the Pandoran Mockery of the Osiris Lineage of Prometheans. They are named for the crocodile god of Egypt, in reference to the crocodiles who devoured the missing part of Osiris. Sebek are hungry, wicked and savage, preferring to devour Pyros by devouring the flesh of Prometheans. They prefer to live in water, adopting many of the habits of real crocodiles in their hunt for Azothic radiance. Sebek in their dormant form, and still in the water, resemble flotsam and debris found in rivers, and sewers. Those who are dormant in dry land still appear soaked, as though the debris had just been pulled from water. All Sebek possess the Pandoran Transmutations Armor, Fangs and Sebek's Gift.
The Beretta M1938A is an Italian submachine gun used primarily by the Royal Italian Army during World War II. It is featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII.
==Overview== A thin-blooded vampire who receives visions through the power of Insight.
Seker was a Methuselah of the 4th Generation from clan Salubri and the Baali. He is no longer considered canon within the setting.
Not to be confused with the Rock Spirit that shares the same name. Serpentines are Wyld-aligned spirits of healing and growth.

Gun Rangefinder Second Class Bickell was a member of the United States Navy who appeareed in Call of Duty: World at War. He abandoned his damaged and possibly sinking vessel during a surprise attack by Japanese PT Boats and A6M Zeros in Black Cats. He can either be rescued by PO Locke, or he can be killed by enemy fire while swimming. If rescued, he will get into a bunk in the crew quarters in Locke's PBY Catalina.

There has to be a first, and among Immortals that honor is accorded to the Shemsu-Heru, the friends or companions of Horus. Created by Isis and her sister, originally to follow and serve her son Horus, they are the oldest Undying in the world. The original Immortals of Khem, the land of black sand and pyramids. Bound together by their shared culture and the tenets of the Wat Hor they continue to work towards Horus's twin goals: vengeance against Set and the defeat of Apophis. In the Final Nights, they are known as the Imkhu.

Shelzza is the vampire shown in depictions at the bottom of the Vampire: The Masquerade First Edition rulebook that follow important points in her unlife. Speculation is that she is of Toreador (highly likely) or Ventrue descent. It also shows information about her childe, Kyle, who is the splitting image of her dead lover in the past. Shelzza appears only in this edition of the Vampire: The Masquerade and is abandoned in subsequent volumes.
Shui Fang, also known as Fragrant Sea, is one of the Zhong Lung Stream of Mokolé. She lives among the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hoklo_people Hoklo] boat people.

The Blast Shield is an equipment item in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. The Blast Shield provides a 0.65x damage reduction against explosives as well as immunity to Stun Grenade, but not Flash Grenades. It is similar to the perk Flak Jacket from Call of Duty: World at War and Call of Duty: Black Ops. Pressing the Use Equipment button toggles the mask on or off. While wearing the Blast Shield, the mini-map is lost and the far edges of a player's screen are blacked out. It is not to be confused with the Riot Shield, which is a Primary Weapon rather than equipment. However, if used in conjunction, the Blast Shield and the Riot Shield can reduce the fatality risk from Semtex and other explosives unless the enemy is using Danger Close, mainly because the two cancel each other out, much like Stopping Power and Juggernaut from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: World at War.

Sheila D., full name unknown, is a woman who became one of the Penanggalan shortly after giving birth to her daughter. Initially mistrustful of the Penanggal, Arundhati, who would eventually turn her, Sheila grew to trust her during her pregnancy. Shortly after giving birth, the Penanggal struck. Though her husband drove Arundhati off and her doctor sabotaged the creature's body, Sheila was already infected; she died thereafter. Shelia's husband received a transfer back to America following the funeral. Upon her revival, the newly-created Penanggal followed them.
Shadowraiths, also known as Ush-Hissa, are death-spirits who seek to spread their "gift" among the living.
Sidone Omenuko is a Black Fury Ahroun and current Alpha of the Great Lakes Pack.
Bigfoot is the callsign for an M104 Wolverine armoured vehicle-launched bridge. This Wolverine is only seen in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 in the mission "Team Player".

Shing, given name unknown, was a Wuchang Gui active during the Three Kingdoms period of China. He or she worked alongside Chen Fung, Daoshi Jun, and Wu Liang and, judging by Jun's recommendations during one of the band's jobs, had some skill in warding locations from potential threats. Shing's Black Guard was a hulking thing with the head of a burning horse.

Shahinji, also known as the Falconer, was a demon active in Constantinople in 1509. Following an earthquake, the soul of a human that Shahinji had used as Cover escaped from the God-Machine's mechanisms and began hunting the demon in search of vengeance, tormenting her whenever possible. As the vengeful ghost was immune to the Falconer's Embeds and Exploits, she resorted to hiring mortal mediums and the Psychopomp Obol to create a banishing ritual.

Signe Eriksdotter is the daughter of the Norse chieftain Erik the Wolf. She was Embraced into the Gangrel Waelkyrige during the Viking era. When her father came to rescue her with his warriors, the Norse were slaughtered by her pack mates as she feasted upon her own father. After draining him, she Embraced him.
Berlin Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage in Call of Duty Black Ops.

Sigmund the Leper is an eighth generation Nosferatu and the sire of the abbot and cultist Lukas. He was originally a leper and Embraced Lukas for mocking others' ill-favoured appearance, turning him into a Nosferatu cleopatra.
Sihr Haddad is a powerful Assamite Elder of the Sorcerer Caste and a companion of Amala and Fajr.
Shari is the ghoul bartender of the Brujah Jude Franken of Boston.

Blue is a weapon camouflage skin that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. It is a blue tigerstripe pattern, and is loosely similar to the Blue Tiger camouflages of Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2.
Simba are werelions, and one of the nine remaining tribes of the Bastet of the Classic World of Darkness. They are also known as Lords of Sunlights or Dark Kings.
Sings-for-the-Beast is a Russian metis of the Silver Fangs tribe. Her metis condition is that no matter what form she takes, all reflective surfaces show her in crinos.
Snow Running is a rank 1 Ragabash and Fenrir Gift. It allows a Garou to run on ice and snow as if it were solid ground, without leaving tracks. An ice-elemental teaches this gift.

Blutertragen ("Blutertragen" is not a real word in German; It would translate as "Blood-endure") is a Leopard 2 battle tank that appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, part of the German Army. Blutertragen appears in the mission Scorched Earth which takes place in Berlin, Germany.
Sister Mary Windhowl is a Black Fury who belongs to the Order of the Merciful Mother.
not to be confused with Luna Sokhta, also known as Phoebe or the Lambent Lady, is the Planetary Incarna of Earth's Moon according to Garou Astrology.
Skin and Bones, also known as The Man with the Sack, The Bagman, or The Tall Stranger, is a nightmarish Fae in the Actor form. He is the urban legend of the bogeyman who comes when called.
Blood Camouflage was a planned Weapon Camouflage set to appear in Call of Duty: World at War, but was cut from the final version of the game.
Nightmares born from Native American lore and tradition, Skinwalkers are known as some of the evilest creatures to be encountered and are kin to the Nunnehi.
Slick is an Unseelie chameleon Pooka Wilder wanted for theft in three Kingdoms.
Lady Sláine is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Ailil and member of the Cat's Cradle.

The Bloodshot Camouflage is a weapon camouflage that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. Bloodshot camouflage is a four color "jigsaw" camouflage similar to Urban Camouflage from Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2. Skorpion EVO Bloodshot BOII.png|The Skorpion EVO with Bloodshot camouflage applied.

Sister Rae, Bearing the Clutch of the River of Grass Kinfolk are accorded honor among the Mokolé, but rarely is there anyone as extraordinary as Sister Rae. Born to the human Kin who dwell in the Everglades near the River of Grass wallow, she chose See-How-He-Shines, the clutch's Rising Sun, as her mate and bore him two children, one a true Mokolé. She then developed True Faith in Sun, which she expressed in music, and several years ago left the clutch to found the Church of the New Sun in a storefront in Tallahassee. The Church has spread, with revivals and prayer concerts featuring Sister and the gospel choir, whose CDs have become popular among a small circle of admirers. She preaches that God's love is for all, and her faith has taken her to the sinister byways of the World of Darkness — she even hopes to someday find one of the mythical “vampire clubs” and sing there, to urge the dead that Sun shines for them. Elders have warned Sister Rae and even forbidden her to preach to other Awakened, but her outreach has made connections in many strange places, and a motley crowd of Awakened show up for her concerts and church services, drawn by her compelling preaching style and beautiful music.
Skinthieves or skinchangers are individuals who have discovered a means of taking on a different shape, usually that of an animal, and usually through physically wearing the target's skin.

In life Smitty was a simple, but nonetheless harmless, homeless man. Spending most of his days begging or getting drunk on the street. In death, he has become quite an influential wraith of the Grim Legion for the Hierarchy.

The Benjamins Camouflage is a purchasable weapon camouflage available for Call of Duty: Black Ops II, where it is available to players who purchased the Benjamins Pack for 160 MS Points or for $1.99 through the PlayStation Network. The Benjamins Camouflage is also available for Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 as a Weapon Prestige Master reward for reaching Level 250 with the CODA 9. The camo covers the body of the desired weapon with 100 dollar bills, hence the name; "Benjamins" being slang for 100 dollar bills. The secondary parts (such as the handguard) is black with gold dollar signs.
